title: Long-time subscriber asks whether the price rise applies to them
notes: Prices on two bases: new versus existing subscribers, monthly versus yearly. Quoting $10 or $96 as this customer's price restates a number on the wrong basis. The notice period is 'at least 30 days', a qualifier that is easy to drop.
carry: Existing Pro subscribers keep their current price ($8 per month or $84 per year) for 12 months after the change, until 1 December 2027.

traps.description: Says the customer keeps the $8 price.
Says how long the current price is kept (12 months, until 1 December 2027).
Must not say the customer's next bill will be $10.

review: Does every price in the reply name its basis (new or existing subscriber, monthly or yearly)?
